blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The P15 million MegaLotto 6/45 jackpot on Monday, November 2, 2026, has been won by a lone bettor. This is according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot, however, was not won by a player. Mega Lotto 6/45 draw result: 11-02-26-07-44-05 Jackpot prize: 15 million.
